TUN.note: Nothing on AI rules or an AI authority.

facts.fact: Assabah News reports that Tunisia's National Business Registry launched two AI services on 5 November 2026: Nawarni, a chatbot guiding founders through company creation, and a bot to check and reserve trade names, built with HiiL and funded by the Netherlands embassy.

TUN.note: The bots serve the business registry, not a health, education, tax or similar sector system.
The bots were built with HiiL; no local model, dataset or AI computing is stated.
The article describes two assistant bots; it does not say firms register online or share a number.
